title: EventGrammarV1
description: Universal experiment-event envelope. Standardizes the outer structure of a material-making/measuring event (intent, observations, outcome, provenance, labels-after-raw); domain payloads stay namespaced and free-form inside observation.payload. Design note: docs/spine/event_grammar_validation_note.md. The CaCO3 pilot schema (material_event.schema.json) is a domain instance; this envelope is the cross-domain core that dataset adapters target.

system.description: Material system or domain, e.g. calcium_carbonate, drying_droplet, li_ion_cell, thin_film_library.

intent.description: What was planned BEFORE execution: the recipe/design settings, stated separately from what was observed. Null when the source dataset records no plan.

event_group_id.description: Replicate / planned-condition group id, for retrieval and held-out-plan splits.

planned.description: Domain-specific planned parameters, namespaced keys encouraged (e.g. droplet.substrate, cell.charge_policy).

observations.description: The trajectory: time-, space-, cycle-, or order-indexed observations. Raw payloads inline (payload) or by reference (file_path). Process readings, measurements, and notes are all observations (kind).

modality.description: e.g. xrd, raman, saxs, waxs, video, photo, rheology, cycling, process_log, human_note.

stage.description: e.g. precursor, in_situ, intermediate, final, aged.

order_index.description: Fallback ordering when no physical time/space coordinate exists.

file_path.description: Reference to the raw payload on disk, relative to the dataset root.

outcome.description: What happened in the end. failed / ambiguous / aborted are first-class citizens, not missing rows.

summary.description: Domain-specific outcome summary, namespaced keys encouraged.

provenance.description: Collection context. Fields may be null, but the object is required so absence is an explicit recorded fact, not an omission.

labels.description: Human/machine labels attached AFTER the raw record is frozen; downstream probes, never the primary record.
